name: Chennai Cubing Club Meetup 2023

venue.name: Temple Tree Beach House
venue.address: Dolphin City, Krishnankarannai Village, SH 49, near ICICI Bank ATM, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 603104

information:
#### THIS IS A LATE NIGHT COMPETITION:
* Ensure your availability at the venue before the registration starts at 8 PM and ends at 11:55 PM. 
* Food and accommodation is not included in the registration fees.
* Participants will receive an email with the amount to be paid if they want to avail food and accommodation. 
* If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your ID card as well.
* The competitors have to strictly adhere to the safety guidelines of the Beach house.
* Participants can opt to stay or travel back to their place after the competition.
